AssayDetails: Male taxi drivers from Chongming (less polluted site) and Shanghai urban city (more polluted site), age from 28 and 55. 30 subjects from Chongming and 30 subjects from Shanghai, with 15 smokers and 15 non-smokers in each condition. The subjects were selected randomly with the balance of location, smoking habits and age group. For each subject, the first D-squame tape sample from right upper cheek of Phase I were used.
objectives: To explore any of acute impacts of air pollution on skin barrier function, functional biomarkers (e.g. anti-oxidants, inflammatory factors etc.), skin barrier recovery, anti-oxidant and anti-microbial capacity through comparing two groups equipped with and without car air purifier in a four-week trial during a heavily polluted season (winter).
